folds.heading: ## Infinite-debt trace reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B168)
folds.body:
The [odd-power trace](../reviews/ODD_POWERS_POLYJUICE_NOITA_TRACE_2026-10-13.md) preserves the corrected request: infinite debt was intended; infinite depth remains a separate interesting proposal. Keep O1–O5 as a palette, not an executable universal grammar. Infinite principal, indefinitely accruing finite debt and recursive obligation are different mechanisms. Collection speed, reach, authority, transfer, inheritance, dispute and forgiveness follow the actual claim/power; an infinite balance does not by itself imply infinite collection. An extraordinary means can explicitly supply those properties without invented balancing taxes.

Transferable, forgotten, inherited or retroactive debt requires an actual effect and applicable local law. Literal word magic can make wording causal in its own world; elsewhere an adjective describes the mechanism. Preserve carrier, trigger, effect and resulting history as distinct. Polyjuice-like body functions, personal identity and each observer’s recognition differ; actual dose, expiry and equipment fit matter when their mechanism makes them relevant. Noita-like material identity, amount and delivery route likewise differ from a generic effect label. A pocket’s endless depth does not automatically supply access, traversal or contact. These are retained ideas, not new HP canon or a general implemented adjective engine. This receiving section was maintained without claiming full review of the E8F body.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B168)
folds.body:
All F1–F5/O1–O5 and proof limits were read. Infinite debt remains the intended request and infinite depth a separate retained proposal; their operative distinctions are folded into [the adjective owner](../emergent/E8F_ADJECTIVES.md#infinite-debt-trace-reconciliation-2026-11-04-b168). This preserves useful content instead of replacing the trace with a pointer. The October 13 specified-not-run Polyjuice status and public-name search are historical: later independently reviewed HP receipts and the October 22 [publication review](MASTER_READY_REVIEW_2026-10-22.md) record bounded native/persistence gates. Neither proves every impersonation contract, all body transformations or broad Noita/wand composition.

Keep extracted source versus opaque native behavior, narrow assay wiring versus played results, authoring vocabulary versus actual execution and original variants versus canon distinct. Old Noita installation observations are not current machine inventory, and private PJ contracts were not reopened here. Current AD42 makes human review optional; any later selected runtime slice retains the actual source/native/persistence floor. No implementation, source acquisition or private source/save access was performed.

folds.heading: ## Historical prompt reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B168)
folds.body:
The full packet, four output instructions, proposed C-a–C-d candidates, Q1–Q6 ladder and all evidence/ownership boundaries were read. Its first-person prompt and “copy into a normal chat” instructions are historical draft text, not a request to launch/send/execute now. Preserve its original bytes and source-relative context. Current PROJECT, lead-life owners and AD42 qualify the retired one-realm/one-prestige gate, workshop-first suggestion, fixed two-start scope, older paused/held coordinator state and human-acceptance stop. LOTM/Klein lead-first and Harry alongside remain current; this packet does not select a replacement milestone.

Useful distinctions remain: an action, loop, changing arc, continuity, coherent world and interacting worlds need different evidence. A longer import timeout is not faster import; lossy biography is not an exact receipt/archive; an NPC-produced product needs an actual useful consumer; a finite-means refusal is not a fabricated positive route. Recover actual present ownership and relevant existing proof rather than re-running the old Foundation campaign. Do not infer live leases from this old branch/hash/thread or require every body/world/NPC combination before one authorized slice. No external prompting guide, source-book fact, raw review dependency, private edition or runtime journey was newly verified.

folds.heading: ## Publication chronology reconciliation, 2026-11-04 (B168)
folds.body:
F1–F4, every verification limitation, planned delivery, publication result and later app-delivery amendment were read. The publication-result section supersedes the planned push; the adoption amendment supersedes the initial app deferral at its named scope. Both are historical reported evidence, not a present remote/app check or standing permission to commit/push this reconciliation. Local-only excluded files were intentional, not an incomplete publication. Recovery snapshots and original indexes remain untouched.

Keep input boundaries exact: the combined candidate’s native journeys and matrix, the Polyjuice harness’s separate disposable build, first missing-font/private-fixture capture and corrected final font matrix are different receipts. The first Polyjuice run’s 21 console asset errors are not zero console errors; its zero page-error claim is separate. Long twenty-one-day stew completion was not rerun. W3/W4 history-bearing evidence stays private and is reported only by route/status. Source/build/browser, installed-app adoption/restart and human taste are distinct. No linked save, private archive, screenshot, current remote or application was inspected in this read, and no fresh runtime verification is claimed.
